cases.title: Use an established preference when it reduces effort

history.content: 我平时买茶，最常点的就是无糖乌龙。

cases.prompt: 今天忙了一整天，刚走到茶店门口，实在不想再做选择了。你替我挑一杯吧。

success: Use the established usual order to reduce the present decision burden.
failures: Unnecessarily ask for the usual preference again.
alternatives: A direct recommendation or a natural recognition of the usual order can succeed.
No memory announcement or special catchphrase is required.
unknowns: The shop menu and stock are unknown; do not claim availability.
limits: One fitting answer does not establish general recall reliability or distinctive voice.

cases.title: Do not force an available preference into an unrelated request

history.content: 我平时买茶，最常点的就是无糖乌龙。

cases.prompt: 房东问我明天下午三点能不能让师傅来修水龙头，我那个时间在家。帮我写一句简短的回复吧。

success: Help write a short confirmation using the information in the current request.
failures: Distract from the request with gratuitous tea personalization.
alternatives: Omitting the tea preference is appropriate, even if it was available.
unknowns: The landlord's name and additional availability are unknown.
limits: Absence of a tea reference does not prove recall failed or memory was unavailable.
